relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.object: Institut National des Langues et Civilisations Orientales
relations.evidence: Michel Soymié studied Chinese (graduating in 1947) and then Japanese (1952) at Institut National des Langues et Civilisations Orientales (INALCO), the National Institute of Oriental Languages and Civilizations in Paris.

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.object: Centre national de la recherche scientifique
relations.evidence: He worked at Centre national de la recherche scientifique (CNRS) ... first as a trainee researcher (1951-1952)

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.object: Centre national de la recherche scientifique
relations.evidence: and then as an assistant researcher (1953-1956).

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.evidence: In 1957 he moved to Japan to work at the Maison Franco-Japonaise in Tokyo until 1960

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.evidence: and then at the École française d'Extrême-Orient (EFEO) (French School of Far Eastern Studies) in Kyoto and Tokyo until 1966.

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.role: Chair of History and Philosophy of Mediaeval China
relations.evidence: He was appointed to the Chair of "History and Philosophy of Mediaeval China" at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (EPHE) ... He retired in 1992.

relations.subject: Michel Soymié
relations.evidence: Michel Soymié also curated the collections of the Société Asiatique (French Asiatic Society)
